propositions: Private-key PEM material (BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY, BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY, etc.) must be rejected at write time in identity CREATE and KEY_ADD operations before events are appended.
create_identity(keys=[...]) must raise CommandError and append no event when keys contain a private-key header.
add_identity_key(identity, public_key) must raise CommandError and append no KEY_ADD event when public_key contains a private-key header.
The reject_private_key_material guard must match private-key headers case-insensitively across RSA, EC, DSA, OPENSSH, PKCS8, and ENCRYPTED variants.
Legitimate public-key material (ssh-ed25519 AAAA...) must pass validation unchanged in both create_identity and add_identity_key paths.
